verdict.rationale: Jira has documented automation capabilities (Rovo AI-driven rules, automated reminders, workflow rules that move work forward) that run in the background without manual triggering, and its Automation engine is a well-known first-party feature referenced via jira-docs-4. However, the evidence pack lacks detail on autonomy depth (e.g., trigger/condition/action complexity, error handling, monitoring) or independent hands-on validation of these automations running reliably unattended. missing for 10: independent corroboration of automation reliability/autonomy, technical documentation of automation rule engine capabilities beyond marketing copy.
